description: PostSider - open-source social media scheduler for 30+ platforms (backend monorepo)
author: Lumi Zone Łukasz Blania <lukasz@postsider.com>

capabilities.archival_reason: Repository or package returned HTTP 404/Not Found

tool_signatures.name: postsider_list_channels
tool_signatures.description: List the social channels (integrations) connected to this PostSider organization. Returns each channel id, name and platform. Call this first to get the channel ids needed by postsider_create_post.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_agency_overview
tool_signatures.description: Get an organization-wide operational overview for an agency: clients, channels, queued posts, drafts, published posts, errors, recent errors and pending approvals. Useful for morning checks and client reporting.

days.description: Window for recent errors, in days.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_customer_report
tool_signatures.description: Get a customer-scoped agency report with channels, queued, draft, published, error and pending approval counts.

days.description: Window for recent errors, in days.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_list_groups
tool_signatures.description: List configured channel groups. In PostSider a group is a customer, so an id returned here is the customerId expected by postsider_get_customer_report and by the customer filter of postsider_list_posts.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_find_slot
tool_signatures.description: Return the next free scheduling date-time (UTC) for a channel, based on its configured posting queue. Use the returned value as the

tool_signatures.name: postsider_list_posts
tool_signatures.description: List posts scheduled or published within a date range (UTC), newest page first as stored. Filter with

customer.description: Optional customer id to filter by.

state.description: Only posts in this state. ERROR = failed to publish.

channelId.description: Only posts for this channel (id from postsider_list_channels).

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_channel_rules
tool_signatures.description: For one channel, return its platform rules, the maximum post length, the provider-specific

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_post_missing_fields
tool_signatures.description: Return per-channel validation problems / missing required fields for a post, so they can be fixed before publishing.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_post
tool_signatures.description: Get the full organization-scoped post group, including current state, scheduled time, media, channel and publish error. Use this to inspect the result of an asynchronous create or publish operation.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_post_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get performance analytics for a single post over the last N days (where the provider supports it).

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_channel_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get account-level analytics for a connected channel (where the provider supports it).

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_notifications
tool_signatures.description: List recent notifications for the organization (e.g. publish failures, channels needing reconnection).

tool_signatures.name: postsider_pause_publishing
tool_signatures.description: Immediately halt ALL publishing for this organization (kill switch): no

reason.description: Optional reason, recorded in the audit trail and shown to the team.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_publishing_state
tool_signatures.description: Check whether publishing is active or paused for this organization. Useful before scheduling (a paused org rejects new posts with publishing_paused), and to confirm a kill switch is on.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_upload_media_from_url
tool_signatures.description: Download an image or video from a public URL and store it in the PostSider media library. Accepts images (jpeg, png, gif, webp, avif, bmp, tiff; up to 10 MB) and MP4 video (up to 500 MB). Returns a media object

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the image or video to import.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_upload_media_base64
tool_signatures.description: Store an image or MP4 video you hold as bytes (no public URL needed).

data.description: Base64-encoded file content (optionally a data: URL).

filename.description: Original file name, shown in the media library.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_upload_media_from_file
tool_signatures.description: Upload an image or MP4 video from a file path on the machine running this MCP server (your own computer). Supports large videos (up to 500 MB; images up to 10 MB). Returns a media object

path.description: Absolute path of the image or MP4 file on this machine.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_list_media
tool_signatures.description: Browse files already in the PostSider media library (newest first, 18 per page) so they can be reused without uploading again. Each item has

tool_signatures.name: postsider_create_post
tool_signatures.description: Create a post across one or more channels.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_update_post
tool_signatures.description: Edit a post in place instead of deleting and recreating it. Send only what changes:

postId.description: Id of the post to edit.

content.description: New post text (replaces the current text).

images.description: Complete new media list from the upload tools or postsider_list_media. Use [] to remove all media. Omit to keep current media.

date.description: New publish date, ISO 8601 UTC. Must not be in the past for scheduled posts.

settings.description: Provider-specific settings; replaces the current settings object entirely, so start from postsider_get_post.

firstComment.description: New first comment. Empty string removes it.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_update_post_status
tool_signatures.description: Change the status of an existing post (e.g. move between draft and queue).

status.description: New status value: draft or schedule.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_delete_post
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a post and every other channel version of it. The id may be any post in a group: PostSider stores a multi-channel post as one group, and a single id deletes the whole group. Read the post first (postsider_get_post) and confirm the full set of channel versions with the user before calling this.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_request_approval
tool_signatures.description: Push a draft post into the human approval queue for review, instead of publishing or scheduling it directly. The post must already exist as a draft (see postsider_create_post with type

postId.description: Draft post id to submit for approval.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_approval_status
tool_signatures.description: Check whether a post submitted via postsider_request_approval has been approved, rejected (with the reviewer\

tool_signatures.name: postsider_connect_channel
tool_signatures.description: Get the one-time sign-in link that connects a social account to PostSider. The user must open the link and approve access on the platform (an agent cannot do that step). Pass

platform.description: Platform identifier, e.g. x, linkedin, linkedin-page, instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube, threads, pinterest, bluesky.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_set_channel_enabled
tool_signatures.description: Switch a channel off (no posts are published to it, its slot is released) or back on. Enabling can fail when the plan\

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_disconnect_channel
tool_signatures.description: Disconnect a channel from PostSider. Its unpublished posts are kept as drafts (not deleted) and published history stays, but nothing is published to it until it is connected again. Confirm with the user first.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_queue_plan
tool_signatures.description: Read the recurring posting slots of a channel (the queue that postsider_find_slot draws from) and the timezone they are expressed in. Each slot time is minutes from midnight in that timezone.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_set_queue_plan
tool_signatures.description: Replace the recurring posting slots of a channel. Each slot is

days.description: Weekdays 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday). Omit for every day.

slots.description: The complete list of slots. An empty list clears the plan.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Omit to keep the current one.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_get_smart_slots
tool_signatures.description: Suggest the best upcoming publish times for a channel, scored from platform peak hours and the channel\

tool_signatures.name: postsider_set_channel_customer
tool_signatures.description: Assign a channel to a client (customer) by name; the client is created if it does not exist. Pass an empty name to remove the assignment. Clients are what postsider_list_groups returns and what reports and filters use. Needs an admin or owner role.

customerName.description: Client name, or an empty string to unassign.

tool_signatures.description: List the reusable content the workspace has saved: hashtag groups (

tool_signatures.name: postsider_save_library_item

tool_signatures.name: postsider_delete_library_item
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a hashtag group, caption template or UTM preset. Posts already created from it are not affected. Confirm with the user first.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_duplicate_post
tool_signatures.description: Copy a post (text, media, first comment) as a NEW DRAFT, optionally onto another channel (

postId.description: Id of the post to copy.

channelId.description: Target channel. Omit to copy onto the same channel.

date.description: Date for the copy, ISO 8601 UTC. Omit for the next free slot.

tool_signatures.name: postsider_delete_media
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a file from the media library and storage. Posts that still use it will lose the image or video, so check where it is used first and confirm with the user.
